title: Account ownership
description: The owner answers for this account. Other administrators cannot demote or deactivate the owner. Handing ownership over does not change anyone's administrator access.
adminOnly: Only administrators can see who owns the account.
noOwner: This account has no owner recorded.
notOwner: Only the owner can hand ownership over.
noCandidates: There is no other active administrator to hand ownership to. Make someone an administrator first.
passwordHint: Needed to confirm it is you. If you sign in without a password, you must have signed in within the last 15 minutes.
confirmDescription: {{name}} becomes the account owner. You stay an administrator, but you will no longer be able to hand ownership over, and another administrator will be able to change your role.
recentSignIn: Sign in again, then transfer ownership within 15 minutes.
